title: Full CAR lifecycle from finding to closure is reflected live in FindingsRegisterTab and CARDetailDrawer
preconditions: Logged in as an auditor with audit.update permission
An active audit exists with at least one open finding
steps: Open FindingsRegisterTab and raise a CAR against an open finding
Open the new CAR in CARDetailDrawer and upload evidence (status should auto-flip to 'remediation_in_progress')
Log out, log in as a different user (not the CAR's assignee), and verify the CAR as 'passed'
Return to FindingsRegisterTab and confirm the underlying finding's displayed status
expectedResult: The CAR transitions open -> remediation_in_progress -> verification_pending -> closed visibly in CARDetailDrawer at each step, and the linked finding's status in FindingsRegisterTab reflects the CAR's closure without a manual page refresh being required to see stale data.

title: Audit can be approved for closure via AuditClosureTab while major CARs/findings remain open
description: End-to-end reproduction of critical defect CD-001: approveClosure() (audit-closure.service.js:131-170) never queries AuditNonConformance for open findings/CARs before setting the audit to 'closed'.
preconditions: An audit has at least one CAR with status='open' and one finding with severity='critical' and status not closed
Closure checklist items have all been manually ticked complete
steps: In AuditClosureTab, tick every checklist item as complete (checklist items are free text, unrelated to actual CAR/finding state)
As a different user with audit.update permission, click 'Approve'
expectedResult: Current behavior: closure is approved and the audit's status is set to 'closed' even though a critical finding and an open CAR still exist and are visible elsewhere in the same audit. This should be flagged as a release-blocking gap — closure approval must be blocked (or require explicit override with justification) while major nonconformities remain open, per ISO 27001:2022 Clause 10.1.

title: Management review meeting minutes and decisions are captured but omitted from the generated report preview
description: ManagementReview.minutes.content/decisions[] are captured by the ManagementReviewTab UI and persisted, but the management-review-report preview mapper (audit-assurance.routes.js:474-491) only surfaces total_reviews/completed/pending counts and a flat reviewItems table — it never reads minutes off the review documents.
preconditions: A completed management review exists with non-empty minutes.content and at least one decision recorded
steps: Complete a management review meeting in ManagementReviewTab, entering detailed minutes text and at least one decision
Navigate to the Phase 3 report suite and generate/preview the 'management-review-report'
expectedResult: Current behavior: the report preview shows only review counts and a flat item table; the minutes text and decisions entered are nowhere in the generated report, despite being stored in the database. Flag for remediation as a reporting content gap against ISO 27001:2022 Clause 9.3.

title: NonConformanceForm.jsx status dropdown offers every status value with no indication of which are legal from the current state
description: Frontend symptom (D-33) of the backend state-machine gap in AUDT-INT-006: the form exposes the full status enum unconditionally.
expectedResult: Current behavior: the dropdown lists all possible status values (e.g. 'closed' directly selectable from 'open') with no visual distinction between valid next-states and invalid ones, and no confirmation prompt when skipping intermediate states. Flag as a UX gap to pair with the backend transition-validation fix.

title: ApprovalDrawer.jsx does not warn or block when the current user is the same person who submitted the report for approval
description: Frontend-side SoD gap (D-36), distinct from the backend closure-approval self-check in audit-closure.service.js (which only blocks the literal requestedBy===userId case for audit closure, not the broader report-governance approval drawer used elsewhere in the module).
preconditions: Logged in as the same user who submitted a Phase 3 report for approval
steps: Submit a Phase 3 report for approval
As the same user, open ApprovalDrawer.jsx for that report and click 'Approve'
expectedResult: Current behavior: no client-side warning or block prevents self-approval in this drawer. Flag for remediation: ApprovalDrawer.jsx should disable the approve action (or require a distinct approver) when the current user matches the submitter, mirroring the backend closure check.

title: Findings Closure Tracker tab displays CAR aging buckets matching underlying CAR ages
description: Positive-control test: FindingsClosureTrackerTab.jsx (R16) sources age/days_open and aging_buckets from AGING_BUCKETS (phase3-enums.js:246-251: 0-30/31-60/61-90/90+ days) via the preview mapper at audit-assurance.routes.js:454-468.
preconditions: CARs exist open for 10, 40, 75, and 120 days respectively
steps: Open the Findings Closure Tracker report tab for the audit
expectedResult: Each CAR is bucketed correctly: the 10-day CAR under '0-30', the 40-day CAR under '31-60', the 75-day CAR under '61-90', and the 120-day CAR under '90+'.
